summary: Arch Capital Group Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a public offering of $600M 5.250% senior notes due 2036 and $1.4B 5.950% senior notes due 2056 under its existing shelf registration. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with other unsubordinated debt and are not guaranteed by subsidiaries. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
